name: Pastel toy world
one_line: Rounded plastic shapes in mint, pink and butter yellow.
look_words: A bright toy world under even daylight. Mint-green ground, cream paths, pink and butter-yellow buildings, a pale blue sky with a few puffy clouds. Every shape is rounded, chunky and simple, as if moulded from matte plastic; nothing is sharp or thin. Shadows are soft and pale lavender, never black. Orange and violet are kept for pickups and the goal, a clear red for anything that hurts, and the player is a strong blue so it never gets lost. Motion is bouncy: squash and stretch, little hops, wobbling trees. Avoid dark corners, realism, grit, fine detail and bloom.

palette.name: pastel toys
palette.notes: A pale world needs a strong player: keep the blue for the player alone. Orange is pickups, violet is the goal. Text sits on the dark card, not straight on the pale ground.

look_wish: soft rounded shading with a little tilt-shift blur, or none

upgrade.why: makes the whole scene read as a small toy on a table

music.notes: Short happy loop; add a layer when things go well.
